jamal: Hero quote options in doc. Leaning toward the succinct one: "Predictable inference for production teams."

rachel: Uploaded hero images and alt text: "Redwood console showing routing dashboard". Noted contrast issue on card; will tweak.

matt: Form ID hs_form_1109 added; UTMs set: utm_campaign=rdw_launch_q2, utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic.

elaine: Kevin's bench data linked at /analysis/benchmarks/launch-v4.csv 1 legal: is that sufficient?

sara: Yes if phrasing is "up to 30% in our internal tests" and link included. No named competitor comparisons.

publish-bot: Smoke publish test scheduled 2026-03-26T08:30:00Z. I will post pass/fail.

elaine: Checklist (mark in doc):
